title: Equal and unequal influence with an evolving guard
authorization: User requested SIMS comparison with equal and unequal influence and guard active throughout.
model: Two abstract SIMS; the documented local ODE example, plus a labeled shared-target control. No fluid PDE.

guard_modes.shared: Both derivatives use the average of sigmoid(theta+beta*(xB-xA)) and sigmoid(theta-beta*(xB-xA)); both guards evolve and remain equal from equal starts. This explicitly changes the draft response law to supply an exactly equal-transmission control.
guard_modes.directional: Draft response law: A receives target sigmoid(theta+beta*(xB-xA)); B receives sigmoid(theta+beta*(xA-xB)). Equal weights mean equal configured strengths, not necessarily equal realized gains.
guard_modes.frozen: Diagnostic control only: both guards remain at initial .5; not counted among active-guard comparisons.

pulse.shape: sin(pi*(t-onset)/duration)^2 on the pulse interval; zero outside

time.units: dimensionless model time, not calibrated seconds

comparisons.primary: Peak sampled absolute deviation of the unperturbed receiver from its own matched no-pulse trajectory, for A-to-B and B-to-A pulses. Report positive and negative disturbances separately, and pooled mean/range over the fixed synthetic starts.
comparisons.own_baseline: Subtract undisturbed trajectory of same initial pair, guard rule and weights.
comparisons.adaptation: For each active rule and weight compare receiver response to same-weight frozen-guard response.
comparisons.unequal: Keep kAB+kBA=2; change ratio from 1:1 to 3:1 and reverse it. Holding sum fixed does not hold realized gain or response fixed.
comparisons.no_success_target: No required direction or size of scientific effect; numerical screens only.

verification.independent: DOP853, rtol 1e-11, atol 1e-13, max_step .025; all modes/weights/pulses for cases 0 and 6. Separate handwritten scalar RHS.
verification.bounds: Check all RK4 intermediate states; no guard clipping.
verification.fixed_guard: Exact matrix exponential for all no-pulse frozen trajectories.

limits: This tests consequences of an assumed abstract response law, not people, molecules or Navier-Stokes.
Shared-target and directional-target rules are distinct models; never describe their difference as a weight-only intervention.
This is a finite deterministic set of synthetic starts; ranges are not population confidence intervals.
Guard memory relaxes on the chosen time scale; no irreversible memory or rupture is implemented.
No new studies, thresholds, horizons or automatic retries are authorized by this protocol.
publication: One completed report entry; source, raw trajectories, numerical verification and historical source link behind one details link.
